Title: Wiki Validation Current State
Content: MemorySmith validation now has first-class whole-corpus coverage for pages, tasks, and live memory records. `Scripts/Validate-Repo.ps1` runs solution build and tests plus `Test-TaskRecords.ps1`, `Test-MemoryRecords.ps1`, `Test-PageLinks.ps1`, and `Test-PagePathLiterals.ps1`. `Test-MemoryRecords.ps1` executes `LiveMemoryRecordValidationTests`, which copy the live `Data/Memories` corpus into temp storage and verify JSON deserialization, filename or id alignment, folder or status alignment, corrupt-file detection, and application-level validation contracts. Operators and agents should treat these scripts as cheap mandatory gates, but still verify live behavior through runtime surfaces such as `/memories`, `/chat`, `/health`, and `/api/diagnostics` when an issue could be runtime access, rendering, or workflow behavior rather than stored data-shape drift.
